content:
I'm not the type of user who rushes to upgrade the moment a new Apple Watch is released. The Apple Watch Series 10 I was using before was only purchased this January, even though it actually launched back in September 2024. That said, the Apple Watch Series 12 is still a very tempting upgrade for me, even though the design language of the two is largely the same. Here are the reasons why I decided to take the plunge.

That's right, the design of the Series 10 and the Series 12 is pretty much the same. You could even say the Series 12 is a slight step backwards, since the bezels are a bit thicker. But that's not an issue for me, because the watch face I use has a black background anyway.

However, the new features on the Apple Watch Series 12 really caught my eye. In particular, the significantly upgraded heart rate monitoring and the all-new Readiness app are the main reasons I'm drawn to it. The Series 12 also feels noticeably faster in everyday use, especially Siri.

Previous Apple Watches have never fully met my health-tracking needs. The Series 12, on the other hand, offers far more insight. In the past there was basically just the Activity rings and a load of data scattered throughout the Health app. Now, the new version of the Health app presents everything you need to know in a clear and extremely practical way.

I'm still wearing my WHOOP for the time being, mainly so I can compare the two over the long term before giving it up entirely, but so far the Apple Health app has performed well, and I'm pretty satisfied with the health-tracking features on the Apple Watch Series 12.

Top-rated comment posted by Nutmac

Michael didn't mention the battery life improvement, which is actually quite significant. With my everyday usage, I can easily get past 24 hours on a single charge.

It's worth noting that WHOOP is a subscription service costing $239 a year, but compared with the Apple Health app, it no longer offers much of an advantage.

All in all, the main reason I bought the Apple Watch Series 12 is that Apple has made a major leap forward in health wearables — the Apple Watch no longer feels like a feature you can take or leave.

My top Apple accessory recommendations:

  • Anker Ultra-Slim MagSafe Battery Case
  • AirPods Pro 3 (twice the noise cancellation of the AirPods Pro 2!)
  • Anker Nano 45W fast charger (with smart display)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W slim MagSafe charger
  • Logitech MX Master 4 mouse designed for Mac
  • AirTag 2 4-pack (Precision Finding improved by 50%!)
  • Belkin MagSafe 3-in-1 iPhone charging stand
  • MOFT MagSafe iPhone stand wallet
